Description
GAI Consultants, Inc is seeking a Bridge Project Engineer to work within our Western Pennsylvania offices with our Transportation Business Unit. The successful candidate will enjoy working in a …
Experience Required
8+ years of engineering experience on a variety of bridge types (structural steel and precast concrete).
Experience with AASHTO and PennDOT standards, structural directives, speciﬁcations, and design manuals.
Experience with structural analysis and bridge design.
Proﬁciency in Midas, CSI Bridge, AASHTOWare BrR, AASHTOWare BrD, MDX, Leap Bridge Concrete, and other design and rating software packages.
Proficiency in MicroStation and Open Bridge Designer.
General Characteristics
Applies thorough knowledge of current principles and practices of engineering related to the variety of aspects affecting the transportation business.
Applies progressively acquired expertise to resolve crucial issues and/or unique conditions.
Keeps informed of new methods and developments affecting their practice and recommends new practices or changes in emphasis of projects.
Leads projects of moderate complexity and scope or leads a major project.
Attends professional society events and develops industry relationships.
Analyzes ethical dilemmas to determine appropriate courses of action. Applies broad knowledge of principles and practices in a specific practice area.
Ability to properly apply and communicate engineering concepts, processes, materials, or products.
Competitive salary - GAI is committed to paying market-based salaries
